protocol.fixed_transfer: NN speed,point tree two-seed mean flow;no winter channel-weight search
protocol.data: All original fit targets plus4point remasks;only public raw-fit labels;original45day profile fixed
protocol.weight: Half original,half4views;uniform regime/date/row;effective mass original target count,as A103
protocol.memory: Preallocate disk-mapped float32 features,float64 scalar teacher/base/weight,int32row keys;chunk-by-view fill
protocol.speed_tree: Reuse original baseline speed tree unchanged,only as placeholder in flow models;transfer speed comes from frozen NN
protocol.cal_gate: Fixed transfer accepted only if pooled cal gain>=.0005 and no regime cal loss>.001;else keep NN. No other weights tested
protocol.assessment: Old public assessment regression only,read after all fits and cal seal
protocol.future_scope: Fixed before new flow fits;public research dates,prior unrelated studies possible,not final/private
